title: Agent adapter capability and lifecycle contract
invariants: An adapter cannot start before discovery or after a terminal state.
Every lifecycle result preserves one exact task revision, session/worktree binding, and adapter identity.
Interaction accepts only bounded digest references; prompts, transcripts, credentials, paths, and raw output are not adapter contract data.
Unknown operations, states, fields, capabilities, and revisions are rejected.
A terminal transition fences all later operations; failure is not reported as successful completion.

compatibility.canonical_json: UTF-8 JSON, sorted keys, compact separators, no trailing newline

privacy.projection: identities, states, bounded dispositions, and digests only

limitations: The reference adapter is an offline state machine and does not launch a provider, process, network connection, or LLM.
Capability discovery does not prove provider availability or authorization; Coordinator, AWQ, AWG, and UI remain authoritative for their domains.
Resume, supervision, resource containment, durable journaling, and provider-specific adapters are deferred to later ARs.
follow_up: AR-0005 defines supervisor and worker lifecycle authority.
